mapper.sql: id, user_id, conversation_id, username, ip, role, model, content, total_tokens, prompt_tokens, create_time

where.if: AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%') OR user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT user_id, username, model, COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens - prompt_tokens), 0), 0) AS completion_tokens, MAX(create_time) AS last_call_time FROM aigc_message
GROUP BY user_id, username, model ORDER BY total_tokens DESC, last_call_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT user_id, username, model FROM aigc_message
GROUP BY user_id, username, model ) t

SELECT COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens - prompt_tokens), 0), 0) AS completion_tokens, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), username)) AS user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT model) AS model_count FROM aigc_message

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens - prompt_tokens), 0), 0) AS completion_tokens FROM aigc_message
GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY stat_date ASC
